description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which extends Fragment. It manages a LogView embedded inside a ScrollView to display log messages within an Android application. The class includes methods to initialize views, set padding, and keep the view scrolled to the bottom when new log data arrives.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains a LogView for displaying log messages, with embedded ScrollView for scrolling. It sets up the view hierarchy and manages scrolling behavior when log text is updated.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView and a nested LogView, setting layout parameters, padding, typeface, gravity, and text appearance, then returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views using inflateViews, sets up a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom when log text changes, and returns the created view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
